description: Test suite for shared channel and remote cluster management in Mattermost, including permission checks, pagination, and remote cluster info retrieval.

methods.name: setupForSharedChannels
methods.description: Initializes test environment with shared channels enabled and configures server URL.

methods.name: TestGetAllSharedChannelsWithSharedChannelManagerRole
methods.description: Tests visibility of shared channels for users with shared_channel_manager role.

methods.name: TestGetAllSharedChannels
methods.description: Tests pagination and error handling when retrieving shared channels.

methods.name: TestGetRemoteClusterById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of remote cluster info for valid and invalid IDs.

methods.name: TestCreateDirectChannelWithRemoteUser
methods.description: Tests creation of direct message channels with remote users, including shared channel invitations.

methods.name: TestGetSharedChannelRemotesByRemoteCluster
methods.description: Validates fetching shared channel remotes filtered by remote cluster with permission checks.

methods.name: TestInviteRemoteClusterToChannel
methods.description: Tests inviting remote clusters to channels, permission checks, and error cases.

methods.name: TestUninviteRemoteClusterToChannel
methods.description: Tests uninviting remote clusters from channels, permission checks, and error cases.

methods.name: TestSharedChannelEndpointsWithSharedChannelManagerRole
methods.description: Checks API endpoints for shared channel remote management with shared_channel_manager role.

methods.name: TestGetSharedChannelRemotesByRemoteClusterWithSecureConnectionManagerRole
methods.description: Verifies access to shared channel remotes with secure_connection_manager role.
